page.overview:
What is Panpour?

Panpour is bipedal monkey-like Pokémon. It is mainly cyan blue in color. Its belly, face, arms and lower body are cream colored. It appears to have its eyes closed. On the top of its head is a blue tuft that holds nutrient-rich water. It has large light and dark blue ears. Its hands, feet, lower torso and legs are a tan color. It has a club shaped tail that's blue, but the rest of the tail is tan.

Despite being adept swimmers, they spend most of their time on land foraging for Berries. Panpour can store water in the tufts of fur on their heads, allowing them to travel long distances while staying hydrated. Flexible, hose-like structures run down their backs and through their tails, enabling them to shoot water out of their tails at varying pressures to defend themselves from enemies. In addition to storing water, these tufts also infuse the water they store with nutrients and minerals Panpour obtain from their food. This makes Panpour water very nutritious, particularly for plants. Though Panpour cannot plant their own sources of food (as they seem unable to make the connection between seeds and plants), they are smart enough to learn how to water plants in order to encourage their growth. Plants watered by Panpour grow exceptionally large thanks to the fortified water Panpour spray. In hot weather, Panpour may spray themselves in order to cool down.

Panpour evolves into Simipour if it touches a Water Stone.

Panpour is based on a and a . The tuft of hair atop Panpour's head is also shaped like a ripple of water. Along with the other elemental monkeys, it seems to be based on the , with Panpour representing "see no evil" by having its eyes closed.
